Day 5 Recipe
Southwestern Turkey Pocket Fajita
Serves 4
Stir together yogurt and lime peel in a small bowl; set aside.
Drain pineapple; reserve 2 Tblsp juice.
Combine reserved juice, turkey, lime juice, and cumin in non-metallic dish.  Cover and
marinate 15 minutes in the refrigerator.
In a non-stick skillet, combine the turkey mixture and onion and cook over medium-
high heat, stirring until turkey is slightly browned.  Add bell pepper and pineapple;
